composition.platform_inputs: carriers.json and both linked binaries, symbols, disassembly and allocated-section placements
checks: Admit the existing startup composition and decoded targets.
Require exactly one task-storage, root-task and app-callback piece.
Reject startup carrier intersections with either platform carrier union.
Stage the actual aggregate over admitted startup loader bytes.
Require inverse platform restoration to recover the admitted startup DAT.

composition.runtime_witness_scope: Nested startup attach/application contracts describe the pre-platform input and require requalification on the final package.
composition.bounded_native_join: Uses final loader plus its recorded startup reference; admits emitted dispatcher/caller spans in final image4 and maps selected owned app and retained guard/checker bytes from that image. It does not execute the complete image4 or root boot.

estimate_evidence.basis: Native proposals cover raw cache and materialized work plus state/input blobs, not the whole historical multi-generation app cache. These are conservative proposals, not measured new-source cohort sizes. The earlier private packet's 1 GiB proposal remains historical and is not an outstanding commitment.

cache.expectations: Rejudged on every read; cached observations are not cached acceptance.
cache.scope_reuse: Cyclic smoke changes the ordered batch and cannot assume full-cohort reuse. Timer initialization batches and app lifecycle prefix can be reused only if all identities remain equal. Changed runner bytes/path prohibit preclaimed old-runner hits.

root_lifetime_source.request_lifetime: Cyclic create consumes the temporary five-word registration request synchronously; no root-stack address is published by this registration.
root_lifetime_source.cleanup_caveat: dispatch_terminate_task C is NONMATCHING. The stated cleanup calls and lack of an explicit cyclic-unregister call are byte-grounded, not a claim that this C body matches.
